g.text: CUT BY THE E-STOP: powered through K1

g.desc: CUT BY THE E-STOP: powered through K1

g.text: 1. Every GND symbol is the one common ground bus at the battery negative.

g.desc: 1. Every GND symbol is the one common ground bus at the battery negative.

g.text: 2. Three fuses only: F_BAT at the battery, F_ML and F_MR on the drive drivers.

g.desc: 2. Three fuses only: F_BAT at the battery, F_ML and F_MR on the drive drivers.

g.text: Everything else is protected by F_BAT, so keep its 18-22 AWG runs short.

g.desc: Everything else is protected by F_BAT, so keep its 18-22 AWG runs short.

g.text: 3. The E-stop opens the K1 coil circuit, and K1 cuts +24V_MOT: drive, arm,

g.desc: 3. The E-stop opens the K1 coil circuit, and K1 cuts +24V_MOT: drive, arm,

g.text: dispenser and headlights. The Jetson, Pico, sensors and LEDs stay on to

g.desc: dispenser and headlights. The Jetson, Pico, sensors and LEDs stay on to

g.text: 4. D1 (1N4007) across the K1 coil absorbs the coil's turn-off spike.

g.desc: 4. D1 (1N4007) across the K1 coil absorbs the coil's turn-off spike.

g.text: 5. Labels with the same name (+BAT_SW) are the same net: join with terminal blocks.

g.desc: 5. Labels with the same name (+BAT_SW) are the same net: join with terminal blocks.

g.text: 6. Signal wiring (Pico pins, encoders, LED data, MOSFET gate) is a separate diagram.

g.desc: 6. Signal wiring (Pico pins, encoders, LED data, MOSFET gate) is a separate diagram.
